answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a reef bet on surviving 102 epochs of grading, and every thread settlement recomputes the trellis schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 102 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
